response.text: {"name":"En pes naenkrat","idea":"The page is built on the salon's single rule, one dog at a time, and on its range of sizes from chihuahua to Bernese mountain dog, drawn as a quiet ladder of outlines on a forest-green field.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"text","hex":"#14201a"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#4f5e55"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#1f4a36"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f2f5f0"},{"role":"accent","hex":"#e3a52a"},{"role":"border","hex":"#cbd5cc"},{"role":"band","hex":"#163a2a"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#eef2ea"}],"pairing":"bricolage-figtree","typeCharacter":"Bricolage Grotesque is friendly and slightly odd, like a dog that tilts its head; use it only for the h1 at about 9vw in weight 700 and for section headings at 40 to 56px in weight 600, sentence case, tight leading; Figtree carries all running text at 18 to 20px, weight 400, with the one name Nina Mihelič and the phone number set in Figtree 600; nothing is uppercase, nothing is italic, the amber accent is never used as text on white, only as rules and small fields.","composition":"Section 1, hero, white ground, 4 rows: columns 1 to 8 carry the h1 at about 9vw in Bricolage, left aligned, starting on row 1 and breaking over three lines; below it the lead in Figtree spans columns 1 to 6 and under the lead sits the single action button, a square-cornered forest-green block reading Pokličite za termin with the phone number itself as plain text beside it. Columns 9 to 12 are a full-height forest-green #1f4a36 field bled to the right page edge and to the top; inside it, one simple line drawing in #f2f5f0, a single sitting dog outline, placed low and alone with generous empty green above it, nothing else in the field. Section 2, the size ladder, white ground, 2 rows: a thin amber rule across all 12 columns on top, then three dog outlines in #1f4a36 line drawing placed on columns 1 to 3, 5 to 7 and 9 to 12, each drawn larger than the last, with the words mali pes, srednji pes, veliki pes in Figtree 600 under each; this ladder is also the key to the price list. Section 3, prices, white ground, 3 rows: heading Cene storitev in columns 1 to 5, the explanatory sentence under it in columns 1 to 5, and the five offerings as a ruled list in columns 7 to 12, each row a service name on the left and an empty right side with a thin #cbd5cc rule beneath, no prices invented. Section 4, how I work, forest-green band #163a2a across all 12 columns, 2 rows: heading Kako delam in #eef2ea in columns 1 to 4, and the four highlights as a two-by-two list in columns 5 to 12, each item a short amber square bullet followed by text in #eef2ea at 20px. Section 5, story, white ground, 2 rows: heading Salon na Ljubljanski cesti in columns 1 to 7, text in columns 1 to 6, and in columns 8 to 12 a small forest-green field holding the name Nina Mihelič and the line that she has been grooming for 8 years, set plainly in #f2f5f0. Section 6, hours and place, white ground with a light #cbd5cc rule on top, 3 rows: heading Delovni čas in columns 1 to 4 with the week strip beneath it spanning columns 1 to 6; in columns 8 to 12 the address Ljubljanska cesta 22, 1330 Kočevje in Figtree 600 above a simple schematic map in #1f4a36 lines on white, with a small amber square marking parking in front of the door and the words Parkiranje pred vrati beside it. Section 7, call, forest-green band #163a2a across all 12 columns, 2 rows: heading Termin za vašega psa in #eef2ea in columns 1 to 6, the sentence beneath it in columns 1 to 6, and the phone number as one large numeral in #eef2ea at about 7vw spanning columns 7 to 12, aligned right; no button here, the hero button is the only one. On phones every section stacks in one column with the green hero field moving under the headline, and the size ladder keeps its three outlines in one row at small scale.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. In the size ladder three standing dog outlines, forest-green line on white, rise from small to large left to right, a chihuahua-sized shape, a mid-sized shape, a Bernese-sized shape, each drawn with the same line weight and no detail beyond the silhouette.
